t04.why_warp: the WARP (G200, G400 family) sets triangles up with its own edge rule, not exactly the Voodoo's: coverage differs on edges (warp=0 keeps the exact rule)

virge.why: the ViRGE/DX's set-up evaluates edges exactly (20 fractional bits), the Voodoo's in sixteenths of a pixel: coverage differs by a pixel where an edge passes within a sixteenth of a centre (0.06% of t04)

radeon.why: the Radeon sets triangles up itself from vertices in sixteenths of a pixel with an exact top-left rule; the Voodoo's rule for a centre exactly on an edge differs, and no finer bias reaches the chip (it rounds to sixteenths): coverage differs by a pixel on some edges (0.08% of t04)

virge.why: W-buffering in a 16-bit Z (a linear 1/w, as the Matrox cards keep it in 32 bits): coarse far away

tnt2.why: W-buffering in Z16 (a linear 1/w); the chip's float Z was worse (docs/tnt2.md)

r128.why: W-buffering in Z16 (a linear 1/w, as the TNT2's): Glide's aux buffer is 16-bit

radeon.why: W-buffering in Z16 (a linear 1/w, as the TNT2's): Glide's aux buffer is 16-bit

virge.why: gamma not applied: the ViRGE/DX's DAC in 15-bit (86Box's model has no ramp there; bench C to settle)

t18.why: 86Box's Voodoo LFB path ignores lfbMode Y-origin and RGBA lanes, so lower-left locks and ABGR writes are wrong in the reference; those regions are excluded

t20.why: 50% blend is G100 stipple: compared box-filtered

t13.why: cells in 'approx' need an add, a subtract or a texture-alpha factor: the G100 has none of them, the G200 adds via specular but cannot subtract or blend by texel alpha; docs/combine-coverage.md
t13.why_virge: the ViRGE/DX's texture environments are DECAL, MODULATE and the sum, blending by the texel's or the vertex's alpha, not their product: adds with alpha, subtraction, texel-alpha lerps, the specular forms and alpha products are approximated

t23.why: benchmark: reports HX-STAT bench lines, nothing to compare
